abstract: Gross and histological examination of residual retroperitoneal mature teratoma revealed different findings in patients treated with PVB remission-induction chemotherapy with maintenance chemotherapy followed by an RLND 4-6 months after PVB chemotherapy (group I) as compared to patients who received PVB chemotherapy only and underwent an RLND after 4-6 weeks (group II). RLND specimens in group I predominantly contained mature teratoma with organoid differentiation, whereas the specimens in group II often consisted of small mature teratoma areas with less-differentiated structures next to large areas of fresh tumor necrosis. Our findings suggest that, either due to maintenance chemotherapy or due to a prolonged time interval between PVB remission-induction chemotherapy and RLND, mature teratoma grows and differentiates further from tissue level to organoid level.
abstract_ja: PVB寛解導入化学療法に続いて維持化学療法を行い、その4~6か月後にRLND(後腹膜リンパ節郭清)を施行された患者(I群)と、PVB化学療法のみを受け4~6週後にRLNDを受けた患者(II群)において、残存する後腹膜成熟奇形腫の肉眼的・組織学的所見を検討した。I群のRLND標本は主に臓器様分化を伴う成熟奇形腫を含んでいた。一方、II群の標本は、大きな新鮮な腫瘍壊死領域の隣に、より未分化な構造を伴う小さな成熟奇形腫領域を含むことが多かった。これらの所見は、維持化学療法またはPVB寛解導入化学療法とRLNDの間の期間が長いことにより、成熟奇形腫が組織レベルからより分化した臓器様レベルへとさらに増殖・分化することを示唆している。
